snippet.title: [RF Online Next] Meet the Biosuit : Demolisher
snippet.description:
Witness the Demolisher's overwhelming firepower that obliterates all enemies! The battlefield's ultimate finisher has arrived!

A biosuit equipped with devastating heavy weaponry, representing the pinnacle of firepower.

The Demolisher is a biosuit that excels at mid- to long-range combat.
It delivers devastating physical attacks and provides powerful fire support across the battlefield. 
Drawing destructive energy at the heart of the battlefield, 
It unleashes overwhelming firepower to completely annihilate all enemies.
---------------------------------------------------------------
New-dimensional Mech MMORPG, Activate

A colossal mech battle unfolding in another dimension!
Step into humanity’s final story once left to imagination

Pre-register for 『RF ONLINE NEXT』 now and prepare to set out into a new world
